messages:
anya (Marketing): Quick preflight: draft ready for final pass. Need headline lock, benchmark phrasing, gated webinar CTA, and HubSpot wiring. Target publish: Fri morning.
rob (Product): Reading now. Suggest we avoid 'X times faster' — go with concrete med/p95 deltas + test notes.
tess (Growth): Agree on med/p95. For CTAs: (A) 'Get the benchmark kit' (gated), (B) 'Request a demo' (sales motion). Keep the kit short — 3 slides + results.csv.
jorge (Design): Uploaded 2 hero comps: compact-console.png and trend-sparkline.png. Prefer compact-console for smaller breakpoints. Can shorten headline to one line.
anya (Marketing): Can we make headline variation A: "Predictable latency for real-world apps" and B: "Lower p95 latency, same quality"? Which reads better?
rob (Product): A feels product-y but safe. B calls out p95 which is our signal. I'd pick B but tweak to "Lower p95 latency at comparable quality."
tess (Growth): Let's A/B headline on preview. CTA placement: primary = demo, secondary = benchmark kit gated modal. For traffic, we send 60% to demo, 40% to kit for first 48h.
devon (Growth Ops): HubSpot plan: two lists -> "product_article_demo" and "product_article_kit". utm_source=organic, utm_campaign=release-q2. Form embed goes to both lists depending on CTA. Snippet to use: `<!-- HS form -->
<form data-portal="98765" data-form="zxy123">... </form>`
anya (Marketing): Devon can you also add lead scoring rule: add +30 if they download kit, +50 if they request demo. Anything above 60 goes to SDR.
devon (Growth Ops): Yep. Also will set email confirmations: kit -> autoresponder with link to gated PDF; demo -> Calendly invite + follow-up workflow.
rob (Product): Appendix request: please include test harness details: dataset sim-load v2, 8GPU batch, sequence 1024. I'll paste the snippet in the doc.
jorge (Design): Small copy ask: subhead should say "real-world p95" not just "faster". I updated the mock.
tess (Growth): Webinar tie-in — schedule Thurs 11am PT. We'll gate the kit behind registration. Use short form fields: name, company, email, role.
anya (Marketing): Timeline: copy freeze 18:30 PT, design freeze 19:00 PT, HubSpot wired by 20:30 PT, staging preview 09:00 UTC Fri. Any blockers?
devon (Growth Ops): On track. I'll post the final form code in the doc and create the two lists.
rob (Product): Dropped the appendix and a clarified benchmark sentence in the doc: "50% lower median; 28% lower p95 vs baseline under synth-load v2" with footnote on metrics.
tess (Growth): I'll prepare two CTA variants for the A/B and create tracking tags for each email.
anya (Marketing): Nice. Once HubSpot confirm is in doc I will run a quick editorial sweep and hit publish-preview. :eyes:
deploy-bot: preview scheduled: staging page build queued for 2026-03-26T09:00:00Z for thread 1735559876
anya (Marketing): Thanks all. If you made edits in the doc, drop a short note here so I can re-check before freeze. :sparkles:
